answer: Put every new agent on a narrow ledge where rewards start tiny and only grow as it crosses a ridge of small verified jobs, each step locking a little collateral in a vault that opens only after unrelated established peers attest the work. A sybil farmer would have to fund hundreds of vaults and tend each ledge for weeks, so the cost stays low for one honest newcomer but multiplies into a fortune for a swarm, while real agents climb the ridge once and keep the vault's trust forever.
